name: Beloved Zofia
desc: The **Beloved Zofia** is a wrecked ship found in the [Voidsea](location:voidsea) behind [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa). The ship is similar in appearance to [The Scoundrel's Bounty](location:the_scoundrels_bounty), where the Tutorial takes place.
additional_info:
-   While the _Beloved Zofia_ is not the ship in the tutorial, they share similar - if not the exact same model. The Beloved Zofia is just a slanted version of the [The Scoundrel's Bounty](location:the_scoundrels_bounty). This is likely just due to them both being the same make of ship.
-   The ship is named after the Beloved Zofia, the signature weapon of Celica in _Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia._
